shares.title: Lives of the Saints · St. Marguerite Bourgeoys · Teaser
shares.message:
At twenty, a girl walked in a procession, and her life changed. This January, her story.

Lives of the Saints · St. Marguerite Bourgeoys
A vertical drama in six parts. Part I, Monday, January 11, 7:30 PM ET; one part each evening through Saturday.

Every line comes from the record of her life; what comes from tradition is told as tradition.

Narration is an AI voice; film and stills are AI-generated (Meta AI, Google Gemini). Score by Luis E. Bonilla, made with AI tools (Suno).
